text:
Aria: quick note  observed an alignment regression when runtime v2.16 serves quant-v4b on long-chat flows. proposing a canary-only pin of runtime -> v2.15 for tonight's window at 01:00 UTC. @deploybot can you stage?

Ben: what's the rollback trigger?

Aria: rollback if generation quality delta >0.7% on the eval set OR p95 latency >350ms for 10m. also abort on 5xx spike >0.3%.

Clara: I'll run the eval suite and SDK smoke for streaming + batch. ETA 00:30 UTC.

deploybot: request accepted. `job_id=pin-rt-2024-772` `op: pin runtime:v2.15 -> cohort:canary` `start: 2024-05-20T01:00:00Z`

infra: runbook linked /runbooks/runtime-pin. infra will mirror traffic to v2.16 for offline diffs and keep sampling at 0.5%.

Clara: SDK smoke: Python/Node pass. small streaming chunk timing flake in Node14; not blocking.

deploybot: executing pin at 01:02Z actual. logs: [01:02:10Z] drained host canary-4; [01:03:00Z] applied routing -> v2.15; [01:04:00Z] verification OK; cooldown 5m.

Nick: telemetry saw a transient p95 bump to 265ms for ~3m due to cache warmup. no 5xxs.

Aria: good. no rollback. leaving pin in place for canary only, hosted/dedicated untouched. tagging infra ticket for GC tuning.

Ben: please add a one-line to release notes: "Canary pin to runtime v2.15 due to alignment regression on quant-v4b; monitoring ongoing."

Clara: will follow up with SDK PR for Node chunking.

Aria: thanks all, closing thread. short updates only.
